brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the Zakat Committee office in an area south of Tulkarem, the Shehab Wire reported. The operation resulted in the detention of several Gaza Strip residents present at the facility. The military did not immediately clarify the circumstances surrounding the presence of the Gaza residents at the charitable office or provide details on the number of people taken into custody.

The Zakat Committee operates as a charitable and welfare organization serving Palestinian communities across the West Bank. The raid follows a series of military operations conducted by Israeli forces in towns throughout the region as part of ongoing security activities in Palestinian territories. The Tulkarem area has seen repeated incursions by occupation forces in recent months.
